notes:
- Simpler menus: related screens now share one page and you switch between them with the buttons in the page header, without opening new tabs
  - All transactions: accruals, collections / payments, income / expense and transfers
  - Daily cash book: cash book, close day and closed days
  - Definitions: account, transaction and finance definitions
  - Reports: financial position, account reports, due analysis (including due tracking) and payment type reports
- On list pages the filter and "New" buttons sit above the table, next to the search box
- Every button, menu, tab and choice now has an icon
- Transaction types have their own screen under Definitions and are available in every bookkeeping mode
- The chart of accounts and the financial reports are shown or hidden together: only in the advanced bookkeeping mode
- When the Windows screen saver or computer lock starts, LedgerPro locks its screen instead of signing you out
- In entry forms the account list opens after you type 3 letters, and a new account can be added with the icon next to the account field
- Note fields in entry forms are a single line
- Resetting data or loading sample data uses your country's chart of accounts
- The country chosen at setup shows in Settings > Company
- Receivable accruals offer income categories, payable accruals expense categories
- The account list has a "Show accounts with no balance" option, off by default
- Required fields are marked with *
